title: ipomoea tenuiloba var. lemmonii
intro: Ipomoea tenuiloba var. lemmonii, commonly known as Lemmon's morning glory, is a type of flowering vine native to the southwestern United States and Mexico. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including the relief of anxiety, insomnia, and muscle spasms. The therapeutic actions of Lemmon's morning glory include sedative, anxiolytic, and antispasmodic effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides. However, more research is needed to fully understand the mechanisms behind its therapeutic effects and to confirm its safety for human consumption.
